2134-4050-7683-8240.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a spell this turn.
2134-4050-7683-8240.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and Prismari trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the Prismari trigger, copying Bond of Insight a number of times.
Resolve the first copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat step 5 for other Bond of Insight copies as appropriate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

647-2023-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6255--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-2158-3249-3621.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-3621.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

3899-4089-5011.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3175-3605-3899-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1482-2866-3899-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6495-7192.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-7192.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1621-1895-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-3755-4460.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3368-5647-7680.description:
Cast Rootcast Apprenticeship by paying {3}{G}. Choose its second mode three times targeting the Meteorite.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, copying Rootcast Apprenticeship, targeting the Meteorite with all three modes, and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Rootcast Apprenticeship copy, creating three copies of the Meteorite token. 
When the Meteorites enter, they trigger, dealing 6 damage to any target.
Activate the three Meteorites by tapping them, adding {2}{R}.
Roxanne triggers three times, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

624-2523-2869.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phantasmal Image dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Phantasmal Image that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Phantasmal Image token instead.
624-2523-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

856-2099-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

321-399-2475-4668-6707.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
321-399-2475-4668-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2438-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-5686-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

851-2457-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

225-4693-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-4693-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-4693-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

1718-3327-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4381-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2933-4499-6441.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3812-5724-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3812-5724-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1018-1987-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1018-1987-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

2292-2850--71.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the ability from step 1, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1308-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1308-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1308-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 3.

435-654-1227-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
435-654-1227-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Auratog ability from step 2, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1368-2034-3263-4408.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2034-3263-4408.description:
Cast Venture Deeper from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill four cards and then exiling Venture Deeper.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2034-3297-4338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Cleric.
2034-3297-4338.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Zombie" on Rotlung Reanimator to "Cleric" until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other Cleric, adding {C}{C}.
Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Cleric creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

656-2034-2399-4487.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Phyrexian Marauder.
656-2034-2399-4487.description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Marauder to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant for {1}.
Sacrifice Ugin's Conjurant to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {1}.
Repeat.
